prompt: I'm launching a SaaS product called 'Luminary' — an AI-powered analytics dashboard. Create a landing page with React + Vite. I want: glassmorphism cards, an aurora gradient animated background, a pricing section with 3 tiers, a features section with animated icons, and a hero with a 3D sphere using Three.js. Dark color scheme, purple/blue accent.

assertions.text: Generates a complete React + Vite project structure with package.json
Implements glassmorphism styling (backdrop-filter, rgba background, border)
Has a pricing section with exactly 3 tiers
Has a features section with visible animation
Implements a Three.js or R3F 3D hero element
Uses the product name 'Luminary' and the purple/blue color scheme
